Game Overview

At its heart, Stunt Santa is a racing game about guide Santa on a chaotic sleigh ride to save Christmas by collecting scattered presents. Navigate through challenging levels with precise timing and control, avoiding obstacles along the way. Experience festive graphics and discover power-ups for added fun in this thrilling holiday adventure. Can you master Santa's mission?
